title: The Patient Visitor
premise: Ivo Montrose, a property surveyor, is hired to appraise Hollowmere House, a derelict estate whose previous owner vanished three years ago. As she documents the property, she discovers the house responds to measurement — rooms shift, the well refills itself, and her sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions no one asked aloud. Digging into the estate's records, Ivo learns the vanished owner conducted a ritual to summon something that grants survival at a terrible price: it keeps one person alive by consuming everyone who learns the truth. When Ivo's sister Priya arrives uninvited and becomes the entity's next target, Ivo must choose between loyalty to family and exposing the truth that could free them both. In the final confrontation at the well before dawn, Ivo renames the entity — binding it with its true name spoken from the original deed — collapsing the bargain, though she survives forever marked as the thing that was invited in.
about_author: I. M. Eriksen is the pen name of a former building inspector who spent a decade cataloguing condemned properties across the northern coast. Their fiction draws on the unsettling intimacy of empty houses and the paperwork of disappearance.

chapters.title: The Commission
chapters.summary: Ivo accepts an appraisal job for Hollowmere House despite its reputation; POV Ivo. The emotional beat is professional detachment masking unease — she needs the money after her divorce and tells herself houses are just assets.

chapters.title: Square Footage
chapters.summary: First walkthrough; Ivo measures rooms that refuse consistent dimensions, and the laser level returns readings from a floor above the roofline. POV Ivo. Beat: rationalization begins — old foundations settle, instruments fail.

chapters.title: The Well at the Property Line
chapters.summary: Surveying the boundary, Ivo finds a stone well exactly on the lot line, dry but echoing like it holds water. A neighbor warns her not to lean over it. POV Ivo. Beat: first genuine fear, quickly suppressed.

chapters.title: Prior Owner, Prior Loss
chapters.summary: At the county archive, Ivo reads about Edith Vann, who bought Hollowmere three years ago and vanished mid-renovation. Her file contains a survey report identical to Ivo's own. POV Ivo. Beat: dread of pattern recognition.

chapters.title: Overnight Retainer
chapters.summary: The client insists Ivo stay on-site to complete the appraisal; she sets up in Edith's half-furnished bedroom. POV Ivo. Beat: reluctant commitment, the point of no return crossed casually.

chapters.title: Noises With Explanations
chapters.summary: First night: footsteps overhead in a single-story wing, pipes knocking in sequence. Ivo catalogs explanations in her notebook like line items. POV Ivo. Beat: the discipline of denial.

chapters.title: The Recording
chapters.summary: Reviewing her sleep-app audio for snoring, Ivo hears a second voice answering questions she never asked aloud — 'How long?' 'Until the well refills.' POV Ivo. Beat: the rational framework cracks.

chapters.title: Questions in Sleep
chapters.summary: Ivo deliberately leaves the recorder running and writes questions on paper before bed; the voice answers them all correctly, including things only Edith could know. POV Ivo. Beat: terror sharpening into compulsion.

chapters.title: Priya Calls
chapters.summary: Ivo's estranged sister Priya, worried by Ivo's rambling voicemail, announces she's driving up. Ivo lies that everything's fine. POV Ivo. Beat: guilt — she knows telling anyone is dangerous.

chapters.title: Edith's Marginalia
chapters.summary: Behind wallpaper, Ivo finds Edith's journal pages: she summoned something to survive her terminal diagnosis, and it kept its promise by keeping her — somewhere. POV Ivo. Beat: horror of understanding the mechanism.

chapters.title: The House Appraises Back
chapters.summary: The house begins valuing Ivo: doors open to rooms containing what she most wants, priced in small losses — a memory, a scar, her mother's ring gone. POV Ivo. Beat: seduction of the bargain.

chapters.title: Priya Arrives
chapters.summary: Priya arrives unannounced at dusk and crosses the threshold before Ivo can stop her; the door locks behind her. POV alternating Ivo/Priya. Beat: panic — the entity now has two claimants.

chapters.title: House Rules
chapters.summary: Priya, skeptical, tests the house and gets answers; Ivo confesses everything, recordings playing. Priya believes her too fast. POV Priya. Beat: loyalty rekindled under threat.

chapters.title: What Was Invited
chapters.summary: In Edith's hidden study they find the invitation document — a deed amendment naming the entity as co-owner, 'in perpetuity, until the well refills.' POV Ivo. Beat: the truth has a legal shape; Ivo thinks in contracts.

chapters.title: The First Withdrawal
chapters.summary: Overnight, the house takes from Priya: her sense of smell, then her memory of their father's face. Ivo watches her sister grieve something she can't name. POV Priya. Beat: the price made intimate.

chapters.title: Neighbor's Testimony
chapters.summary: The elderly neighbor reveals Edith isn't the first — every owner since 1911 signed something, and each 'vanished' owner is still audible in the walls on certain nights. POV Ivo. Beat: scale of the horror widens.

chapters.title: Listening to the Walls
chapters.summary: Ivo records inside the walls and isolates dozens of voices, including Edith's, all repeating fragments of their invitations. One voice begs Ivo by name. POV Ivo. Beat: justice outside the law — these people were never declared dead.

chapters.title: Calling the Authorities
chapters.summary: Ivo reports a crime; a deputy visits, feels nothing, and leaves skeptical — the house performs normalcy for outsiders. After he goes, the temperature drops as punishment. POV Ivo. Beat: institutions fail; the law cannot enter here.

chapters.title: The Entity Speaks Directly
chapters.summary: For the first time the voice addresses Ivo awake, offering to release Priya if Ivo signs a new amendment extending the term. It speaks in Edith's recorded cadence. POV Ivo. Beat: temptation framed as mercy.

chapters.title: Reading the Deed
chapters.summary: Ivo studies the 1911 original deed and finds the entity's name redacted — struck through with a notation: 'named, therefore bound; unnamed, therefore fed.' POV Ivo. Beat: hope with a terrible condition.

chapters.title: Where Names Are Kept
chapters.summary: Research leads to a defunct title office and a retired clerk who remembers the redaction order came from the Vann family — Edith's ancestors sealed the name to protect themselves. POV Ivo. Beat: the trap is generational.

chapters.title: The Clerk's Warning
chapters.summary: The clerk, dying and unafraid, explains the ritual logic: the well refills when the entity has consumed enough truth-bearers; speaking the name before sunrise on the refill night ends it — or joins the speaker to it. POV clerk/Ivo. Beat: rules crystallize; stakes clarify.

chapters.title: Priya's Bargain Attempt
chapters.summary: Desperate to spare Ivo, Priya secretly offers herself to the house in exchange for Ivo's freedom. The house accepts — and begins draining her faster. POV Priya. Beat: loyalty weaponized against them.

chapters.title: Finding Priya Changed
chapters.summary: Ivo wakes to find Priya glassy-eyed, reciting inventory of the house like an appraiser, her own memories converting to square footage. POV Ivo. Beat: rage and guilt fused.

chapters.title: Negotiating With Walls
chapters.summary: Ivo attempts to renegotiate using contract language, exploiting loopholes in the amendment; the entity enjoys the game and grants concessions that cost more than they save. POV Ivo. Beat: her professional skill becomes survival tool and trap.

chapters.title: Edith's Voice, Closer
chapters.summary: Edith's presence strengthens near the well; through the stones Ivo hears her clearly: she never wanted rescue, she wanted a successor so the cycle would spare her daughter. POV Ivo/Edith interlude. Beat: sympathy for the monster's maker.

chapters.title: The Daughter
chapters.summary: Ivo tracks down Edith's adult daughter, who confirms the family has fed the thing for four generations and begs Ivo to let it refill quietly rather than risk waking it fully. POV daughter/Ivo. Beat: the theme sharpens — some survivals are inherited debts.

chapters.title: Refusal
chapters.summary: Ivo refuses the quiet path; that night the house strips her divorce ring's memory and shows her a vision of her own future as a voice in the wall. POV Ivo. Beat: despair bottoming out.

chapters.title: Preparing the Sunrise
chapters.summary: Ivo drafts a new document — not an invitation but a revocation — combining the redacted name's location clues, Edith's confession, and legal language of rescission. Priya, half-lost, helps steady her hands. POV Ivo/Priya. Beat: agency reclaimed through craft.

chapters.title: The House Fights Back
chapters.summary: As dawn approaches, the house rearranges itself: stairs reverse, the study seals, the well begins to fill audibly. The entity offers one final personal temptation — Ivo's marriage restored, whole. POV Ivo. Beat: climax pressure; desire versus truth.

chapters.title: Loyalty Versus Truth
chapters.summary: Ivo realizes accepting the vision would save Priya permanently — at the cost of becoming the next keeper. She looks at her sister's emptied eyes and chooses truth over loyalty. POV Ivo. Beat: thematic crux decided.

chapters.title: Breaking Into the Study
chapters.summary: Together they breach the sealed study physically, Priya sacrificing her last clear memory of childhood to hold the door. Inside, the original redaction ledger sits open. POV Priya. Beat: sacrifice as payment forward.

chapters.title: The Name
chapters.summary: Ivo uncovers the stricken name: Hollowmere itself — the house is the entity, named for the drowned village beneath the well. Speaking it means addressing the ground they stand on. POV Ivo. Beat: revelation reframing everything.

chapters.title: Before Sunrise
chapters.summary: The well brims; voices surge; the house convulses. Ivo stands at the property line with the revocation as the sky lightens. POV Ivo. Beat: held breath.

chapters.title: The Reading
chapters.summary: At first light Ivo reads the revocation aloud, naming Hollowmere, citing every consumed owner as witness. The voices rise in chorus behind her words. POV Ivo. Beat: catharsis — justice performed outside any court.

chapters.title: The Well Refills Anyway
chapters.summary: The name binds but doesn't banish: the well fills, and the house goes silent and ordinary — but Ivo feels the name lodged in her chest like a second heartbeat. POV Ivo. Beat: victory with permanent cost.

chapters.title: Aftermath Inventory
chapters.summary: Days later, Ivo completes the appraisal honestly: structure unsound, value negative. Priya recovers partially, missing pieces she chooses not to mourn. POV Priya. Beat: grief and gratitude entangled.

chapters.title: What Survives
chapters.summary: Ivo files the revocation with the county, making the truth public record where the law finally can reach it. The clerk dies peacefully; Edith's voice is gone from the walls. POV Ivo. Beat: quiet restitution.

chapters.title: The Second Heartbeat
chapters.summary: Ivo returns alone to check the property and finds the well dry again — but when she leans over, her reflection answers a question she didn't ask. POV Ivo. Beat: ambiguity restored; the mark remains.

chapters.title: Closing Entry
chapters.summary: Final chapter: Ivo's appraisal report, appended with a handwritten note — 'Some properties should remain vacant. I will be watching this one.' She takes the neighboring cottage, keeping vigil. POV Ivo. Beat: resolution as guardianship; survival as ongoing price.
